name: An item obtained after login gets its patch row without a stream resend
contract: Requires CoA.SendDisplayPatches=1. The login stream only carries rows for items the character owns at that
moment; it used to be resent on every world entry, which also refreshed items obtained since. Now it is sent
once per login, so an obtained item must get its SMSG_PATCH_ITEM (0x0932) row when it is created. After the
login stream, obtaining Infused, Infernos of Elemental Fury 998102 sends its row once. A far teleport with the client's world-entry notice neither restreams (SMSG_PATCH_LOADING_SCREENS
0x05F8 stays at one) nor sends the row again. A relog streams again and carries the owned item's row.

steps.label: SETUP: the item is not owned yet, so the login stream has no row for it
The obtained item's row is sent when it is created
DISCRIMINATING: no second stream after the teleport
The item row is not sent again
The relog stream carries the owned item's row
